oracle_M.note: ceiling; not a real forward-pass selector, observes the M label directly

semantic_entropy.forward_passes: k=10 (one generation batch of k samples) + up to k*(k-1) NLI calls, per query
semantic_entropy.note: no fit-time cost at all (fully unsupervised, no training step); this is the DIRECT method -- costs paid at EVAL time per query, unlike Semantic Entropy Probe which pays this cost only at fit time and is cheap at eval time by design
